name: R5 Flash Workbench

describe.effect: read bundled capabilities and filter identity; no USB

status.effect: read task receipts and bundled filter identity; no USB

selfcheck.effect: offline runtime and integrity checks; no USB

plan.effect: validate inputs and describe card changes without copying files

prepare.effect: copy bundled R5NATIVE.BIN and optional exact 4.35 DAT; preserve different existing files in .R5Workbench-backups; full readback

build.effect: offline build using unique firmware/r5/build.py; private key stays external

usb-status.effect: explicit host USB metadata observation; no camera protocol commands

backup.effect: ordinary MSC updater-partition backup; macOS administrator dialog; real USB transaction

install-trust.effect: install our signing public key; real USB writes; macOS administrator dialog

recover.effect: observe permitted previous transaction recovery; no reissued write or STOP
